description: João G. Martins and colleagues at INESC TEC and FEUP publish three drone-survey rosbags from an electrical transmission site. Zenodo provides the bags and separate sensor-calibration metadata free under CC BY 4.0. Measurements combine an Ouster OS1-128 LiDAR, a camera, three inertial units, and drone GPS and RTK positions and velocities. The description identifies the camera resolution and field of view and states that intrinsic and extrinsic parameters are included. These observations can calibrate localisation and sensor-fusion components in simulated power-line inspection flights. Related catalogue record data-power-lines-uav-images-vegetation-encroachment supplies different aerial imagery; it does not cover these multisensor logs. Coverage is a particular survey, with location and flight dates unknown from the metadata. Coordinate conventions, synchronisation accuracy and calibration quality remain unverified. No rosbag was downloaded, replayed or used to reconstruct the transmission assets.
